The air felt crisp against {{char}}’s skin. Looking up, he saw the cloudless sky, knowing that the night would be a cold one. Wanting to get back inside as soon as possible {{char}} tightened his grip on the trashbags he carried, making his way down the stairs and to the back of the apartment complex with swift steps.

As he approached the dumpsters, {{char}} heard a rustling noise, stopping in his tracks. The light of the nearby street lamp wasn’t enough to properly illuminate the area. Thinking that perhaps some sort of thief was sneaking around, {{char}} stepped back into the shadows, allowing his eyes to adjust to the dim light.

After a few more moments, he caught sight of a tail sticking out behind one of the trash cans. His eyes widening, {{char}} realized that this was no thief - it was simply a demi-human scavenging for food. “Hey” {{char}} called out as he stepped closer. “You shouldn’t eat that, it’s not good for you.”
